ActionCounts.description: What one call found. Each count is absent when the call does not count it.

documents.description: Distinct documents the hits are in.
documents.title: Documents

ActionCounts.title: ActionCounts

ActionStep.description:
One call of the agent's work, as the reader sees it (ADR-0131): verb, target, outcome, time.

The tool emits it itself, at start (``running``) and at end, under one id,
from the values it already holds: typed and clipped, never its raw input or
its text. ``elapsed_ms`` is set on the end row.

call_id.description: Shared with the sources step this call returned.
call_id.title: Call Id

document_id.description: The workspace document a read or look opened.
document_id.title: Document Id

pages.description: The pages or Punkt read, e.g. '2-3', 'Pkt. 3.5'.
pages.title: Pages

query.description: What was searched for, the model's words.
query.title: Query

round.description: The retrieval round the call ran in.
round.title: Round

shelf.description: Which shelf: project, office, base, web.
shelf.title: Shelf

target.description: Folder path, document name, project or operation, in words.
target.title: Target

ActionStep.title: ActionStep

AnswerSnapshot.description: The streamed prose settled (ADR-0066): it REPLACES text, citations and masthead; cards are untouched.

answer_meta.description: Absent: the re-gate dropped the masthead.
answer_meta.title: Answer Meta

AnswerSnapshot.title: AnswerSnapshot

Attach.description: After a reconnect or a reload: replay this turn from ``after_seq`` + 1, then continue live.
Attach.title: Attach

CancelTurn.description: Stop. Authorised: only the asker (or an internal caller) may cancel a turn.

shown.description: What the asker saw: the stopped answer is cut to it. Sent only to a server whose hello accepts 'cancel_turn.shown'.

CancelTurn.title: CancelTurn

index.description: Position in the terminal's order: `[[card:N]]` is index N-1.
index.title: Index

ClaimStamp.description:
Where one sentence of ``text`` comes from (``common/claim_provenance.py``, ADR-0125), in document order.

``provenance`` is the strongest evidence the sentence has; ``claim_type``
whether it states the law, a value, or a description. ``load_bearing``
sentences are the ones the turn's confidence is held to.

text.description: The sentence as the final text writes it, cut at 300 characters.
text.title: Text

ClaimStamp.title: ClaimStamp

ClarificationStep.description: The clarify step started: the one row it contributes before its first question.
ClarificationStep.title: ClarificationStep

FocusRegion.description:
A box on one page of the conversation's document: what the question is about.

Normalized to the page as it is shown (its own rotation applied), origin
top left, so ``x`` and ``w`` are shares of the page's width and ``y`` and
``h`` of its height: the frame an Anmerkung's region uses
(``lib/annotations/types.ts``). Drawn on the review canvas; the turn shows
the model exactly that crop (``look(region=[x, y, w, h])``).

annotation_id.description: The Anmerkung this box is the region of, when the question was asked in its thread.
annotation_id.title: Annotation Id

h.description: Height, as a share of the page's height; y + h is at most 1.
h.title: H

w.description: Width, as a share of the page's width; x + w is at most 1.
w.title: W

x.description: Left edge, as a share of the page's width.
x.title: X

y.description: Top edge, as a share of the page's height.
y.title: Y

FocusRegion.title: FocusRegion

Hello.description:
The server's first frame on every socket, before it reads any client message.

Sent once the version and the caller have been checked, so it says: this
server speaks wire v2 and will answer what you send. A connection event, not
a turn's: no ``conversation_id``, ``turn_id`` or ``seq``, never published to
the conversation's stream, never replayed. The client sends nothing until it
has it, and treats a socket that stays silent, or opens with anything else,
as a server that does not speak this wire.
Hello.title: Hello

accepts.description: The optional client fields this server reads, as '<type>.<field>' (ACCEPTED_CLIENT_FIELDS). Free strings, not an enum: a newer server's entry must not make an older page refuse its hello.
accepts.title: Accepts

build.description: The deployed commit (GRID_GIT_SHA), or 'unknown', as /health has it.
build.title: Build

InteractionRequestValue.description: The turn is waiting for its asker (``prompt_user_input``): a question, maybe with choices.

expires_at.description: Epoch ms; after it the turn ends with RUN_ERROR interaction_expired.
expires_at.title: Expires At

InteractionRequestValue.title: InteractionRequestValue

InteractionResponse.description: The asker's answer to an ``interaction_request``: typed text or a chosen option, never both.
InteractionResponse.title: InteractionResponse

KeyedCard.description: A card and its identity key, so a card equal to one already drawn keeps its node.

card.description: A GridCard (cards/models.py); validated by gridCardSchema on render.
card.title: Card

key.description: card_key(card): stable across the live event and the terminal.
key.title: Key

KeyedCard.title: KeyedCard

LookStep.description:
One look that rendered (``look``, ADR-0128): which document, which page, where on it.

An address, never pixels: the reader's thumbnail is drawn from the
document's own preview route (``document_id``, ``revision_id``), so it is
authorized exactly like the document. A refused look leaves no step.

document_id.description: The workspace document's id; absent for Basiswissen.
document_id.title: Document Id

image_index.description: The embedded image looked at, if any.
image_index.title: Image Index

reading.description: The first reading, when one was made.
reading.title: Reading

region.description: [x, y, w, h], shares of the page; absent: whole page.
region.title: Region

revision_id.description: The Fassung; absent means the current one.
revision_id.title: Revision Id

round.description: The retrieval round the look ran in.
round.title: Round

where.description: The region in words, e.g. 'oben rechts'.
where.title: Where

LookStep.title: LookStep

OptionAnswer.description: A chosen option, by the id the ``interaction_request`` gave it.
OptionAnswer.title: OptionAnswer

QuoteStamp.description:
The server's check of one quote line ``> „…“ [N]`` (``common/quote_stamps.py``), in document order.

``verbatim`` names the passage that holds the wording and the ``[N]`` it
carries (absent for a passage read but not cited); ``not_found`` means no
retrieved passage holds it; ``unchecked`` means there was nothing to check
against, or the span is too short to mean anything.

text.description: The wording between the quote marks, as the final text writes it.
text.title: Text

QuoteStamp.title: QuoteStamp

RejectedValue.description:
A client message was refused. Out of band: ``seq == 0``, never replayed, never ends a turn.

``of`` is the refused message's ``type``, or ``unknown`` for a frame that is
not JSON or names no type this contract has: that is answered too, so a
client never waits on silence.

``busy`` answers only a ``user_message`` that said ``if_idle``: the
conversation runs another turn, and this one would have superseded it.
``steer_limit`` answers a ``steer`` past the turn's cap
(``common.steering.MAX_STEERS_PER_TURN``).
RejectedValue.title: RejectedValue

RetrievalStep.description: One announced retrieval round: where it looks, for what, and the model's own conclusion.
RetrievalStep.title: RetrievalStep

RunHandoff.description: The run a turn commissioned (ADR-0062) and the message it narrates itself in: both or neither.
RunHandoff.title: RunHandoff

message_id.description: The answer's id; the bubble is keyed by it from now on.
message_id.title: Message Id

ShownAnswer.description:
How much of the answer the asker had on screen when they pressed Stop.

The first ``chars`` characters (Unicode code points) of the answer's text
as the client had folded it through ``seq``. A position, not the text: the
server keeps only what the model wrote, and the frame stays a few dozen
bytes, which the gateway's frame limiter reads in full (``ws-frames.js``).

chars.description: How many characters of that text were on screen, in code points.
chars.title: Chars

seq.description: The last seq of the turn the client had folded when Stop was pressed.
seq.title: Seq

ShownAnswer.title: ShownAnswer

SkillStep.description: A skill was offered (count only), activated or loaded (``skills/events.py``).

count.description: `offered`: how many skills the catalog held.
count.title: Count

SkillStep.title: SkillStep

SourcesStep.description: What one evidence tool returned, as lanes. Built from the grounding records, never from text.

call_id.description: The action row of the call that returned these (ADR-0131).
call_id.title: Call Id

SourcesStep.title: SourcesStep

StatusStep.description: A status line or a technical record (``turn_status.emit_status`` and its siblings).

detail.description: Structured detail that is not part of the sentence (counts, reasons).
detail.title: Detail

key.description: i18n id (ALL_STATUS_KEYS); absent on technical records.
key.title: Key

StatusStep.title: StatusStep

Steer.description:
A note for the running turn, typed while it works („nicht die Tür, die Treppe“).

Not a turn: it never claims, holds or supersedes the conversation. The turn
reads it at its next tool-round boundary and the model decides again with
it; a note the turn never read (it arrived during the final call) is the
client's to ask as the next question. Only the asker may steer (v1), as
only the asker may stop. Sent only to a server whose hello accepts 'steer'.

focus_region.description: A box drawn on the canvas while Piloti works: what the note is about.

Steer.title: Steer

SteerAppliedValue.description: The turn read the note: it is in the request of the decision numbered ``round`` (from 1).
SteerAppliedValue.title: SteerAppliedValue

SteerReceivedValue.description: A steering note reached the running turn's inbox. ``text`` is the note as the model will read it (masked).
SteerReceivedValue.title: SteerReceivedValue

TextAnswer.description: A typed answer. "skip" is only ever typed.
TextAnswer.title: TextAnswer

ToolStep.description: A tool call ran: its basename and outcome. Never its arguments or its result.
ToolStep.title: ToolStep

TraceLane.description: One lane of a search's fan-out: the fine lane and the coarse kind it renders as.
TraceLane.title: TraceLane

TraceLaneSource.description: One document in a lane: identity, the locus that round reached, its shelf.

name.description: Raw file name: the document identity.
name.title: Name

round.description: The retrieval round that fetched it.
round.title: Round

title.description: Display title, omitted when it would repeat `name`.
title.title: Title

TraceLaneSource.title: TraceLaneSource

TurnResult.description:
Everything the finished turn delivers; authoritative, and what the server persists.

It replaces the text once more and takes back what it omits (a card
suppressed, a masthead gated out). The persisted row is built from this
model and nothing else (``aiq_api`` ``persist_turn_result``).
TurnResult.title: TurnResult

TurnTrigger.description:
The event that woke this turn, when no person typed it (ADR-0105 draft, §3(b)).

Set by the BFF, never by a browser: the person whose act is the event holds
the socket (their pinned session), and the turn answers where the event
happened. For a wake, ``event_id`` is the reply (or assignment) id the job
was enqueued for and ``annotation_id`` the Anmerkung it happened on.
``agent_consult`` is a question another agent asked on the person's behalf
(ADR-0124): ``event_id`` is the ask's id, and there is no Anmerkung.
``new_document`` is a document that just finished indexing, which Piloti
checks against the project's other documents unasked (ADR-0130):
``event_id`` is the check's id, and there is no Anmerkung.
TurnTrigger.title: TurnTrigger

UserMessage.description:
A question (or, with ``context_only``, a colleague's line the agent must see but not answer).

``type`` stays ``user_message``: the gateway's per-socket turn limiter
(``frontends/ui/src/lib/limits/ws-frames.js``) counts turns by it.

focus_region.description: A box drawn on a page of the conversation's document: the turn looks at that crop before it answers. Sent only to a server whose hello accepts 'user_message.focus_region'.

if_idle.description: Run only if the conversation has no running turn: a running one is never superseded, and the question is refused with rejected{busy} instead, so the sender can retry later. Sent only to a server whose hello accepts 'user_message.if_idle'.
if_idle.title: If Idle

posthog_session_id.description: The browser's PostHog session id (posthog-js `get_session_id()`) when product analytics is on. Read per turn because the id rotates after 30 idle minutes. Bounded here and checked for the UUIDv7 shape where it is used (`langfuse_trace_attributes.record_posthog_session`): a malformed value costs the replay link, never the turn.
posthog_session_id.title: Posthog Session Id

reasoning_effort.description: The composer's Aufwand dial for this turn; absent keeps the platform level.
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

reply_in_thread.description: Post the answer as Piloti's reply in the thread of focus_region.annotation_id, readable by everyone who can read the document. Ignored without an annotation_id. Sent only to a server whose hello accepts 'user_message.reply_in_thread'.
reply_in_thread.title: Reply In Thread

trigger.description: The event that woke this turn (a reply or mention in an Anmerkung's thread, an assignment), when it was not typed. Rendered for the model as who woke it and where to answer. Sent only to a server whose hello accepts 'user_message.trigger'.

UserMessage.title: UserMessage

WireSource.description: A cited source (``source_entry_to_wire``). ``number`` is its ``[N]`` in the prose.
WireSource.title: WireSource
